_about: Runtime responses captured from the Marrow backend route handler (POST /v1/agent/runtime, real SQLite with the production schema) for the exact request runGuarded() sends: once with the SDK wire shape (slim, selected by X-Marrow-Package) and once with ?response=expanded. Workflow-gate and decision-brief responses are the other two pre-think calls. Slim bodies drop only telemetry blocks (event, latency_budget, capacity_guidance, identified_workflow, failure_mode, client_update, workflow_recommendation, performance timings); expanded bodies are a projection of the fields the SDK reads. Verdict fields are unmodified.
